methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: we propose a two-stage MCDM approach for EEP prioritization by combining a fuzzy analytic hierarchy process (FAHP) to evaluate criteria weights with qualitative data and four methods

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Presents a two-stage MCDM decision-support framework (FAHP for criteria weighting; VIKOR/TOPSIS/WASPAS/PROMETHEE for ranking) to prioritise energy-efficiency projects. No EnPI/EnB measurement model is presented, proposed, evaluated, or critiqued (no baseline, regression, SEC, or energy-consumption normalisation). Per v2.3, MCDM/AHP/TOPSIS/Fuzzy project-ranking scores are decision-support, not EnPI/EnB models; ISO 50001/EnMS is cited only as context.

paper_type.evidence_quote: The proposed framework is applied to a real-life case study of an Egyptian petrochemical complex in a developing country.

stage1.notes: Two-stage MCDM (FAHP weights + VIKOR/TOPSIS/WASPAS/PROMETHEE) ranks 12 EEPs at an Egyptian petrochemical complex; FAHP criteria weights also compared across Egypt/Ireland/Qatar. Ineligible: decision-support ranking, not an EnPI/EnB model. Context is petrochemical (would be Corpus-B if eligible), but level_3b forced false because ineligible.
